posts.name: Mirasol
posts.cooked:
You will want to hit edit on your post and then move your post to the Customer Support forum. To do that, use the drop down menu in the edit window to change it from General Discussion to Customer Support.

That is an Information Desk to help folks navigate the support system, explain policies, explain account services, etc. Nobody there can grant you a refund, but they can help track down missing tickets, figure out why you might be having issues with the refund, etc.

Refunds are now mostly self-help. The system will refund any purchase that is eligible under the Refund Policy without a GM or anyone getting involved. Makes it easy and fast.

You only need a GM if you don’t meet the Refund policy requirements - like using aspects of bundles (game time, boosts, beta access).

Note: If this is a VERY recent purchase and it has not finalized yet then the system can’t refund it. It has to actually complete the transaction before they can refund the transaction. They can’t stop it mid processing.
